## Defect type

- [ ] Two documents contradict each other
- [ ] A responsibility is owned by more than one component, or by none
- [ ] A conflict is unresolved by [Constitution §5](../../docs/01%20Tutor%20Constitution.md#5-conflict-resolution)
- [ ] A requirement is untestable or uses non-specification language
- [ ] A threshold is stated inline instead of referenced from Constitution §9
- [ ] Broken cross-reference or stale metadata
- [ ] Schema does not support a documented behaviour
